name: Sophia Santana
bio:
Sophia Santana is a Brazilian actress and producer. She starred in the feature film Road To The Mouth Of Hell “A Última Casa No Topo da Colina” (2024), playing Bruna — a strong-willed and seductive protagonist in a psychological horror with slasher elements.

The film was selected for festivals such as FANTASPOA, Portland Horror Film Festival, Etrum Horror Film Fest, and Floripa Que Horror!, receiving praise for its intense atmosphere, engaging narrative, and striking performances.

Sophia also played Isis in the film Espaço Liminar, further expanding her work in productions that explore mystery, fear, and emotional depth.

credits.title: Road To The Mouth Of Hell
credits.overview: A group of young people are returning from a trip when they find a teenage girl lost on the road and offer her a lift. After being abandoned by the driver, the group decides to spend the night at the young woman's house. They just didn't expect it to be the worst choice of their lives...

credits.title: Espaço Liminar
credits.overview: Two bounty hunters investigate the apparition of an unknown woman and the dream that connects them under the electronic sky.
